description: This file contains a cache management routine for an LZMA compressed kernel loader, specifically targeting Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes functions to flush the cache over a specified memory range and references to cache operations and configuration headers.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a range of memory addresses by performing cache write-back and invalidation operations specific to the board's architecture.
